unavailable.retainedHeap: Chromium exposes no stable cross-family retained-heap measurement for this contract; lifecycle ownership counters and roots are reported instead.
unavailable.compositorPresentationTimestamp: The headless software browser exposes no physical compositor/display presentation timestamp; each accepted latency sample ends only after Playwright captures the updated SVG pixels.
